rationale: PgConnection's AnyConnectionBackend impl calls Connection::ping(self) with self: PgConnection (fully-qualified trait call), and the postgres integration tests call conn.ping() on a PgConnection from new::<Postgres>(). Generic pool callers (conn.ping() on DB::Connection) also reach it. These are trait-method dispatch gaps no in-scope Rust rule targets.
